content: Many errors stem from heavy use of dialectal Arabic as well as ambiguity. Since BERT was trained on Wikipedia (MSA) and Google books, the model failed to classify tweets with dialectal cues. Conversely, Mazajak/SVM is more biased towards dialects, often failing to classify MSA tweets.
qasper_evidence_text: Many errors stem from heavy use of dialectal Arabic as well as ambiguity. Since BERT was trained on Wikipedia (MSA) and Google books, the model failed to classify tweets with dialectal cues. Conversely, Mazajak/SVM is more biased towards dialects, often failing to classify MSA tweets.
